collection.title: Volvo C70 2006 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Volvo C70 2006 to 2014 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
